text:
I come from a misty far country,

ruled by an old sad monarch...

My muse seeks only what is arcane,

my muse adores only what does not exist.


You weep for a dream that is far away,

you await an affection that no longer exists,

your pupils lose themselves in the arcane

like two black wings, and you are very sad.


You are mine: we were born of the same arcane

and we go, disdainful of all that exists,

in pursuit of that misty far country,

ruled by an old sad monarch...

translation.title: I Come from a Misty Far Country
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the refrain-like arcane country and its melancholy kinship.
